english_pilot.title: I Took the Fight Into the Alien Burrow | Swarm Siege

segments.text: The bugs used to attack my base. This time, I went into their burrow to take on the queen!
This is Swarm Siege, my base-defense game. You are watching an October fourth development build. The interface is still in Chinese.
I head out as the medic. Aiming and firing are automatic by default, so positioning matters. Get into range and the character fires. Space lets me dash away in this build.
Third person helps me watch the surroundings. In this build, V switches to first person. Manual shooting and shortcuts can be changed in the settings.
Before starting the wave, I clear the abandoned supply station, collect its first-clear reward, and spend the coins at the shop.
The machine gun gives sustained fire. A shotgun spreads pellets at close range. During the beacon mission, I stay inside the blue circle and collect coins while fighting.
I can build defenses too. Choose a machine-gun turret, check the placement preview, and confirm. A bad placement can be dismantled for half the cost back.
Next, I hire a teammate and enter the elite nest. The squad helps fight and collect supplies. Mission rewards pay for stronger equipment.
Now I can afford the pulse laser cannon. The next target is deep inside the map: the alien queen.
I follow the central burrow in first person. Beyond the tunnel are the queen and her guards. Do not stop at the entrance. Move into firing range!
The beam keeps hitting and the damage numbers appear. Guards block the way, so I clear the immediate threats before focusing on the queen again.
She is down! In this recorded build, later swarms in the chapter shrink by thirty-five percent. Attacking first takes pressure off the base.
Back on the front line, I intercept the bugs coming out of the burrow. The wave is cleared. Stage two begins with the base still at full health.
With enough coins, I can buy a vehicle. I board it with I in this build, then drive through the gate for a different approach.
Supplies, upgrades, defenses, and a raid on the queen now form a complete route. Tunnel visibility and squad following still needed work at this point.
Would you defend first or raid the queen? The current Chinese-language demo is linked below. Follow its in-game controls. Thanks for watching!

chinese_sentences: 以前是虫子来拆家。
这次，我钻进虫洞反攻母皇！
这是我做的基地防守游戏《虫潮围城》。
画面来自十月四日的开发版本。
游戏界面目前仍是中文。
我先选医疗兵出门。
默认自动瞄准与攻击，所以走位很重要。
进入射程，角色就会开火。
这个录制版本用空格冲刺拉开距离。
第三人称方便观察周围。
这个版本按V切第一人称。
手动射击与快捷键可在设置调整。
开战前，我先清理失落补给站，拿首通奖励，再回商店花金币。
机枪适合持续扫射。
霰弹枪在近距离散射弹丸。
信标任务要留在蓝圈里，边战斗边拾取金币。
防御也能自己建。
选机枪塔、检查放置预览，再确认。
摆错了可拆除，返还一半造价。
接下来雇队友，进入精英巢穴。
小队帮忙战斗与拾取补给。
任务奖励用来换更强装备。
现在攒够钱买脉冲激光炮。
下一目标在地图深处：虫巢母皇。
我用第一人称沿中央虫洞前进。
隧道后就是母皇和护卫。
别停在入口。
进入射程！
光束持续命中，伤害数字出现。
护卫会挡路，先清眼前威胁，再打母皇。
母皇倒下了！
这个录制版本里，本章后续虫潮规模减少百分之三十五。
主动出击能给基地减压。
回到正面战场，拦住钻出虫洞的敌人。
这一波守住。
进入第二关时，基地仍是满血。
钱够了也能买载具。
这个版本按I上车，开出城门换个打法。
补给、升级、防线和反攻母皇，形成了一条完整路线。
当时隧道视野和队友跟随还需要打磨。
你会先守城，还是先打母皇？
当前中文版试玩入口见简介。
操作以游戏内提示为准。
感谢观看！
